name: STI-288GP-BT.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STI-288GP-BT
Product Name	10 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
Fixed Port	8*10/100/1000M RJ45 PoE port / 2*1000M SFP
PoE Ports	1 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, with a maximum power of 90W per port / 2-8 ports support IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum single port power of 30W
PoE Dog	Support
PoE Pin	af/at: 12+ 36- / af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Bandwidth	24Gbps
Packet Forwarding	14.88Mpps
MAC	2K
Buffer	2.5M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PWR: Power indicator (green) / PMX: Power overload indicator (green) / PoE port: orange PoE indicator, green grid connection indicator. / 9-10: Optical fiber connection indicator (green) / V1: Main power indicator (green) / V2: slave power indicator (green)
Power	2 groups of independent power input / POE: DC 37-57V
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 160mm*130mm*45mm / Packing Box: 280mm*165mm*79mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	1.2Kg/1.4Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us; 8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	3 Years
